statement: Russian forces conduct at least one drone or missile strike on Kyiv between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, or BBC report a Russian drone or missile strike on Kyiv occurring between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No Russian drone or missile strike on Kyiv occurs at any point between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
